content.value: A jet of water having a velocity of 30 m/s strikes a series of radial curved vanes mounted on a wheel which is rotating at 200 rpm. The jet makes an angle of $2 0 ^ { \circ }$ with the tangent to the wheel at inlet and leaves the wheel with a velocity of 5 m/s at an angle of $1 3 0 ^ { \circ }$ to the tangent to the wheel at outlet. Water is flowing from outward in a radial direction. The outer and inner radius of the wheel are 0.5 m and 0.25 m, respectively. Determine – (i) vane angles at inlet and outlet, (ii) work done per unit weight of water, and(iii) efficiency of the wheel.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2024
